decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program draws on core clinical expertise, is reimbursed and has stable demand from working patients, so it meets aspirations and the expanding firm has slack to carry it.

Custom-furniture carpentry uses existing sheltered-workshop production know-how at low incremental cost and fulfills the inclusion mission, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger search, although the earlier withdrawal of the workshop retail shop suggests some scrutiny of market-facing workshop ventures.
Senior-living counseling is prominent, cheap to run and channels clients into the core eldercare business, so it clearly meets aspirations.

Meal delivery for seniors is close to the core eldercare offer and was only launched in 2024, and with slack from growth and resources freed by earlier withdrawals, management will give it time before judging it against aspirations.
